units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:1">Yoma VIII, 1</cite> <he>הח׳ תנעול וכ׳</he> a woman after confinement may wear shoes (on the Day of Atonement).
<cite ref="Berakhot 54b:21">Ber. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>חולה ח׳ וכ׳</he> a sick person, a lying-in &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00690"><he>חַיּוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:7">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:5">Gen. R. s. 96</cite>, end <he>אי לכם ח׳ וכ׳</he> woe to you, lying-in women in Palestine; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 7:2">Tosef. B. Bath. VII, 2</cite> <he>נאמנת ח׳ וכ׳</he> the midwife is an admissible witness as to which (of twins) was the first-born; Y. Kidd. IV, 69ᵈ bot.; Y. B. Bath. III, beg. 13ᵈ <he>הח׳ בשעה וכ׳</he> the midwife (is an admissible witness) only as long as she is seated by the obstetric chair (not after she left the mother). Y. Yeb. XVI, end, 16ᵃ <he>עשו אותו כח׳ וכ׳</he> they place him in the same category as a midwife whose testimony is valid on the spot; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:5:1">Cant. R. to IV, 5</cite> <he>מרים</he> … <he>חַיּוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> Miriam … were the midwives of Israel; a. fr.
